== Title ==
<span lang="ja">もうだめだ！</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-120o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ライフフォースが１５より小さいときの相手の支配フェイズに使用できる。場に出す。このターンの残りの間、フォースを失う毎に、失うフォースの数を半分にする（端数切り上げ）。Ｒ２－Ｄ２かＣ－３ＰＯが場に出ていれば、端数切り捨て。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">３ＰＯは、数多くの災難に脅かされ、たびたび作動停止の危機に見舞われた。この不運な通訳ドロイドは、罪のない皮肉感覚が発達し、状況判断力も鋭くなった。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' All Is Lost!

'''Card text:''' During your opponent's control phase, you may play this on table if your Life Force is below 15. For the rest of the turn, halve each Force loss, rounding up. If R2-D2 or C-3PO is on table, round down instead.

'''Lore:''' 3PO has been threatened by many calamities and repeatedly faced shutdown. The unfortunate protocol droid developed an innocent sense of irony and a sharp eye for assessing situations.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
